name: task_demo
notes: HARDWARE task_demo — NOT a pick-and-place. Offsets from the resting pose: one slow close-hold-open cycle of the jaws with no joint motion at all. The simulator's task_demo is a full tabletop pick-and-place; on the real arm the operator's rule is that nothing sweeps through space, so the tier=act beat is the arm quietly working its gripper. Say that out loud: the act decision is real, the arm's hardware repertoire is one gripper cycle. Gripper rate 10 %/s closing and 6.7 %/s opening (limit 12), arm excursion 0 deg.
